recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學影像而非血液形態：左下為核膜完整、染色質無法分辨的間期細胞（interphase），右側為染色體已凝縮並攤開、可見 G 帶條紋的中期分裂相（metaphase），後者才是做核型分析的對象。
features: Grayscale G-banded (GTG) preparation from cultured bone marrow aspirate cells
Interphase cell (lower left): round dense nucleus with no individually discernible chromosomes
Metaphase spread (right): condensed chromosomes spread without heavy overlap, showing light and dark bands
Chromosome count and structural abnormalities cannot be assessed from this unkaryotyped image
describe_en: This is a cytogenetic image, not a morphologic smear, showing a GTG-banded preparation from a cultured bone marrow aspirate. An interphase nucleus (lower left) appears as a dense, round chromatin mass in which individual chromosomes cannot be resolved, whereas a metaphase cell (right) shows condensed, well-spread chromosomes with visible banding. Only metaphase cells with adequate spreading and banding are captured and arranged into a karyogram by length, centromere position and banding pattern; interphase cells require FISH for analysis. No karyotype interpretation is possible from this single spread, and results must be correlated with blood, aspirate and biopsy findings.
